# RPX Focus AI Strategies (auto-generated from rpx_focus_strategies.py)
#
# Each block activates when its specific focus has been completed, detected via
# the country flag of the same name that the focus reward sets on completion
# (focus IDs receive tag suffixes in a later step, so has_completed_focus on the
# base ID cannot be used).
# Multiple blocks with the same type/id stack additively on top of game defaults.
# Per-idea strategies (rpx_ai_strategy.txt) remain separately gated on has_idea.
rpx_focus_strat_rpx_air1_fighter_engines = {

	abort_when_not_enabled = yes

	ai_strategy = { type = unit_ratio  id = fighter  value = 5 }
	ai_strategy = { type = equipment_production_factor  id = fighter  value = 5 }
}
